**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Date:** April 16, 2025  
**Service:** Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775)  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]  
**Decision:** APPROVED

---

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement (≥35 kg/m²):** Met. Current BMI is 36.4 kg/m² per measurements documented in medical record (doc-002).

**Obesity-Related Comorbidities:** Met. Patient has multiple documented conditions:
- Type 2 diabetes mellitus, active since 2016 (cond-006)
- Hyperlipidemia, active since 2018 (cond-009)
- Obstructive sleep apnea, documented November 2024 (doc-003)

**Prior Weight Management Program:** Met. Patient completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Net weight loss of 2 kg was regained after discontinuation, documented as unsuccessful (doc-004).

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy is a covered bariatric procedure.

---

This authorization is valid for 60 days from the date of this letter. Please contact us if you have questions.
